software_name: Commonwealth Casualty Company’s (CCC) Document Templating Engine with AWS
software_desc: The CCC Document Templating Engine is a software application designed to modernize the creation of contractual agreements and document generation for Commonwealth Casualty Company. It leverages Amazon Web Services (AWS) and the Pebble templating engine to facilitate dynamic document creation, version control, and email integration. Key features include document generation in Doc/PDF format, digital signatures via DocuSign, template editing, version comparison, and automated email distribution of generated documents. The system is designed for authenticated CCC employees, ensuring security, efficiency, and accuracy in document handling.

software_desc: The Co-op Evaluation System (CES) is a web-based application designed for students, employers, faculty, and administrators to evaluate and manage cooperative education (co-op) experiences. The system enables students to provide feedback on their co-op experiences, employers to evaluate student performance, and faculty to approve or reject student co-op participation. Additionally, it supports administrators in collecting and analyzing co-op data. The new system aims to replace an outdated version, addressing issues like session timeouts, performance, reliability, and usability while incorporating modern web technologies for better maintainability and user experience.

4. Check the progress status of the evaluation.

Co-op End Date: 30 days from today.
expected_outcome: The system should automatically change the evaluation status from Pending to Open once the configured timeline is met.

software_desc: MusicBox is a system designed to play musical instruments using musical notes. It allows users to load image files or capture images of musical scores, upload MusicXML files, or load previously saved .mip files. The system converts the notes from these inputs into a playable format and controls the instrument via servo motors and solenoids programmed with Arduino Mega 2560. MusicBox aims to make playing musical instruments easier for anyone interested in music, even without formal musical education. The user interface is simple and supports functionalities like playing, stopping, replaying, saving, and loading music files.

The system converts the notes from these inputs into a playable format and controls the instrument via servo motors and solenoids programmed with Arduino Mega 2560. MusicBox aims to make playing musical instruments easier for anyone interested in music, even without formal musical education. The user interface is simple and supports functionalities like playing, stopping, replaying, saving, and loading music files.

software_desc: The Online Shopping System (OSS) is a web application designed to provide a complete solution for both vendors and customers in an electronics shop setting. It allows vendors to set up online shops, customers to browse and purchase products online without physically visiting the store, and administrators to approve or reject new shop requests and manage shop categories. The system supports functionalities such as user registration, login, shopping cart management, payment processing (currently cash-based, with future plans for credit/debit card payments), and report generation. The OSS aims to simplify the shopping experience by enabling users to buy products conveniently over the internet while also offering shop owners an efficient way to sell their goods online.

software_desc: The Project Automate Paint Defect Analysis is a system designed to automate the recording and tracking of paint defects on vehicles during production. It provides a web interface where analysts can input defect data about car models in a standardized manner. The system eliminates the need for paper diagrams by allowing users to mark defects on a digital wireframe of the vehicle, store the defect data in a database, and generate various reports (e.g., weekly charts, quality assurance reports, and summary analysis reports). The software runs on Windows computers at inspection checkpoints and communicates with a backend server to store and retrieve data. The system supports multiple automotive plants and helps reduce resource usage and human error while enabling better tracking and analysis of paint defects over time.

It provides a web interface where analysts can input defect data about car models in a standardized manner. The system eliminates the need for paper diagrams by allowing users to mark defects on a digital wireframe of the vehicle, store the defect data in a database, and generate various reports (e.g., weekly charts, quality assurance reports, and summary analysis reports). The software runs on Windows computers at inspection checkpoints and communicates with a backend server to store and retrieve data. The system supports multiple automotive plants and helps reduce resource usage and human error while enabling better tracking and analysis of paint defects over time.

software_name: Commonwealth Casualty Company’s (CCC) Document Templating Engine with AWS
software_desc: The CCC Document Templating Engine is a software application designed to modernize the creation of contractual agreements and document generation for Commonwealth Casualty Company. It leverages Amazon Web Services (AWS) and the Pebble templating engine to facilitate dynamic document creation, version control, and email integration. Key features include document generation in Doc/PDF format, digital signatures via DocuSign, template editing, version comparison, and automated email distribution of generated documents. The system is designed for authenticated CCC employees, ensuring security, efficiency, and accuracy in document handling.

Customers can check room availability, make reservations, and process online payments, while receptionists manage booking details and customer inquiries. Hotel managers have full control over financial reports, room pricing, and customer data management. The system is built with Java (J2EE), JSP, and MongoDB, ensuring secure transactions, data integrity, and efficient hotel operations.

The system can handle multiple meeting requests concurrently and offers features like virtual meeting support, conflict resolution, and dynamic re-planning of meetings. It aims to streamline the meeting scheduling process while accommodating the needs of various stakeholders, including meeting initiators, participants, and managers.

The system converts the notes from these inputs into a playable format and controls the instrument via servo motors and solenoids programmed with Arduino Mega 2560. MusicBox aims to make playing musical instruments easier for anyone interested in music, even without formal musical education. The user interface is simple and supports functionalities like playing, stopping, replaying, saving, and loading music files.

software_desc: The Online Shopping System (OSS) is a web application designed to provide a complete solution for both vendors and customers in an electronics shop setting. It allows vendors to set up online shops, customers to browse and purchase products online without physically visiting the store, and administrators to approve or reject new shop requests and manage shop categories. The system supports functionalities such as user registration, login, shopping cart management, payment processing (currently cash-based, with future plans for credit/debit card payments), and report generation. The OSS aims to simplify the shopping experience by enabling users to buy products conveniently over the internet while also offering shop owners an efficient way to sell their goods online.

software_desc: The Project Automate Paint Defect Analysis is a system designed to automate the recording and tracking of paint defects on vehicles during production. It provides a web interface where analysts can input defect data about car models in a standardized manner. The system eliminates the need for paper diagrams by allowing users to mark defects on a digital wireframe of the vehicle, store the defect data in a database, and generate various reports (e.g., weekly charts, quality assurance reports, and summary analysis reports). The software runs on Windows computers at inspection checkpoints and communicates with a backend server to store and retrieve data. The system supports multiple automotive plants and helps reduce resource usage and human error while enabling better tracking and analysis of paint defects over time.

The system eliminates the need for paper diagrams by allowing users to mark defects on a digital wireframe of the vehicle, store the defect data in a database, and generate various reports (e.g., weekly charts, quality assurance reports, and summary analysis reports). The software runs on Windows computers at inspection checkpoints and communicates with a backend server to store and retrieve data. The system supports multiple automotive plants and helps reduce resource usage and human error while enabling better tracking and analysis of paint defects over time.

It also supports course registration and management, enabling administrators to assign courses to lecturers and enroll students in those courses. The system provides reporting capabilities, such as generating lists of students, lecturers, and their assigned courses. Built using PHP and MySQL, the application aims to streamline administrative tasks and improve the efficiency of the registration process in an academic setting.

software_name: Commonwealth Casualty Company’s (CCC) Document Templating Engine with AWS
software_desc: The CCC Document Templating Engine is a software application designed to modernize the creation of contractual agreements and document generation for Commonwealth Casualty Company. It leverages Amazon Web Services (AWS) and the Pebble templating engine to facilitate dynamic document creation, version control, and email integration. Key features include document generation in Doc/PDF format, digital signatures via DocuSign, template editing, version comparison, and automated email distribution of generated documents. The system is designed for authenticated CCC employees, ensuring security, efficiency, and accuracy in document handling.

software_desc: The SDMSTM system is a web-based meeting scheduler designed to efficiently schedule meetings by determining the availability of necessary resources, such as participants, equipment, and locations. It supports organizations in planning meetings under constraints expressed by participants, rescheduling based on new or modified constraints, resolving conflicts, and managing interactions among participants. It aims to streamline the meeting scheduling process while accommodating the needs of various stakeholders, including meeting initiators, participants, and managers.

software_desc: MusicBox is a system designed to play musical instruments using musical notes. It allows users to load image files or capture images of musical scores, upload MusicXML files, or load previously saved .mip files. The system converts the notes from these inputs into a playable format and controls the instrument via servo motors and solenoids programmed with Arduino Mega 2560. MusicBox aims to make playing musical instruments easier for anyone interested in music, even without formal musical education. The user interface is simple and supports functionalities like playing, stopping, replaying, saving, and loading music files.

The system converts the notes from these inputs into a playable format and controls the instrument via servo motors and solenoids programmed with Arduino Mega 2560. MusicBox aims to make playing musical instruments easier for anyone interested in music, even without formal musical education. The user interface is simple and supports functionalities like playing, stopping, replaying, saving, and loading music files.

The system converts the notes from these inputs into a playable format and controls the instrument via servo motors and solenoids programmed with Arduino Mega 2560. MusicBox aims to make playing musical instruments easier for anyone interested in music, even without formal musical education. The user interface is simple and supports functionalities like playing, stopping, replaying, saving, and loading music files.
test_case_description: Convert a valid MusicXML file to a playable MP3 format and verify the output.
pre_conditions: MusicBox is powered on. User is logged in. Valid MusicXML file is available.
test_steps:
1. Navigate to the Music Conversion module.
2. Upload a valid MusicXML file.
3. Select "MP3" as the output format.
4. Click "Convert".
5. Download and play the converted file.
expected_outcome: Conversion completes successfully. The MP3 file is playable without issues.

software_desc: The Online Shopping System (OSS) is a web application designed to provide a complete solution for both vendors and customers in an electronics shop setting. It allows vendors to set up online shops, customers to browse and purchase products online without physically visiting the store, and administrators to approve or reject new shop requests and manage shop categories. The system supports functionalities such as user registration, login, shopping cart management, payment processing (currently cash-based, with future plans for credit/debit card payments), and report generation. The OSS aims to simplify the shopping experience by enabling users to buy products conveniently over the internet while also offering shop owners an efficient way to sell their goods online.

The system aims to offer a seamlessly integrated platform that supports various stakeholders in the training process, including administrators, trainers, and trainees. Additionally, the platform is built using open-source technologies like PHP frameworks (e.g., Laravel, CakePHP) and MySQL, ensuring flexibility and scalability.
test_case_title: Verify Keyboard Navigation and Screen Reader Support
test_case_description: Ensure that the platform is navigable using only the keyboard and that screen readers can accurately interpret UI elements for visually impaired users.
test_steps:
1. Navigate through the platform using only the keyboard (e.g., Tab, Enter keys). 
2. Use a screen reader to access different parts of the platform.
expected_outcome: All interactive elements are accessible via keyboard, and screen readers accurately describe UI components and navigation.
